content: Dear all, Analysis/InnerProductSpace/l2Space.lean has the definition HilbertBasis of a (Schauder) basis of a Hilbert space and Mathlib/Analysis/Normed/Module/Bases.lean has the definition SchauderBasis of a Schauder basis of a Banach space. It seems that the proof that HilbertBasis is a SchauderBasis is missing. I'm looking into making a PR adding this result. Where should I write it down?
You can use #find_home to get a suggestion. It is usually reasonable
